_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows book search results as cards with covers, difficulty, and literary regard scores

difficulty_max.description: Highest difficulty score to include (0-100; higher is harder to read)

difficulty_min.description: Lowest difficulty score to include (0-100; lower is easier to read)

genres.description: Only books in any of these genres

locale.description: The reader's language. "ru" adds each book's Russian title and description (title_localized, description_localized) beside the English ones. Set automatically when the query is in Cyrillic.

query.description: Words from a title or an author's name. Close spellings match.

themes.description: Only books with any of these themes, e.g. 'grief', 'war', 'identity', 'memory'

name: search_books

id.description: Work UUID, for book_id arguments of other tools

title_localized.description: Title in the requested locale (present when locale is not en and a translation exists)

top_award.description: Most notable award won, with year

locale.description: Locale the localized fields are in

title: Search books
